subject.title: Isolated cron consistently fails with "LLM request failed" on model-call-started phase

question: Which remaining isolated-cron failure subpaths should this umbrella track after the generic `LLM request failed.` classifier fix: all active cron timeout/recovery failures, or only a narrower subset?
rationale: The report spans multiple live failure modes with separate open trackers and the next fix depends on maintainer policy for cron watchdog, idle-timeout, fallback, and diagnostic recovery behavior.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Until Canonicals Land
options.body: Keep #91363 open as the user-facing umbrella and close it only after #93912, #91892, #97335, and #88870 or their replacements are resolved and verified together.

options.title: Split And Close As Superseded
options.body: Choose one canonical owner for each subpath, comment the mapping, and close #91363 once maintainers are confident the broad user evidence is fully represented elsewhere.

options.title: Narrow To Session Recovery
options.body: Retitle or scope #91363 around the cascading manual-run/session-state symptom and leave watchdog, stream-stall, and fallback policy to their existing focused issues.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella Until Canonicals Land
recommendation.body: Keep #91363 open as the user-facing umbrella and close it only after #93912, #91892, #97335, and #88870 or their replacements are resolved and verified together.

likelyOwner.reason: Josh is the strongest recent history match for cron timeout/fallback policy and the product decision needs that boundary more than a single line-level fix.
